universal_lens: The collective performance manifold is defined by the suppression of individual variance and strict adherence to boundary constraints. gsi_mapping: GSI models team cohesion as a Bayesian network where individual priors are continuously updated toward a global posterior via rigid training rules. primitives.name: Individuality Suppression Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: In a certain sense a player must lose his SACRIFICE individuality and make himself a component member of his team.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: I_i: Individual vector (dimensionless), T_global: Team harmonic state (dimensionless), \alpha: Suppression coefficient [0,1]
primitives.assumptions: Players exist within a shared Hilbert space; total team energy is conserved but redistributed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if \alpha < 0.5, leading to destructive interference and team fragmentation.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSI's ensemble weighting algorithms, suppressing high-variance individual priors to maximize collective predictive accuracy.
layer2.telemetry: Variance reduction in positional tracking data across the roster.

primitives.name: Harmonic Cohesion Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: With the proper spirit of sacrifice in all its members, the team becomes harmonious.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \vec{F}_{sacrifice}: Vector field of individual concessions (J/kg), H_{team}: Team harmony scalar (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: Sacrifice is uniformly distributed; no single agent bears disproportionate load.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Divergence occurs if any member refuses instructions, creating a topological defect in the team manifold.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's optimal play-calling engine, identifying state transitions that maximize systemic efficiency without localized stress.
layer2.telemetry: Spatial clustering coefficients and synchronized acceleration metrics.

primitives.name: Emotional Stability Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: It cannot but be admitted that the man who loses his head in a game is the man who will probably lose the game at a critical moment.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \Psi: Cognitive performance amplitude (dimensionless), \sigma_{emotion}: Emotional volatility (Hz), k: Decay constant (s^-1)
primitives.assumptions: Cognitive bandwidth is finite; emotional spikes consume processing resources required for tactical execution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Critical failure at high temporal pressure when \sigma_{emotion} exceeds the regulatory threshold \epsilon.

layer2.mapping: Directly maps to GSE's situational reasoning module, acting as a veto on suboptimal action vectors triggered by psychological perturbations.
layer2.telemetry: Heart rate variability (HRV) and decision latency under defensive pressure.
